account_suspended.message: This account does not currently have API access.

audio_not_available.message: Audio is unavailable. Send the request without the audio attachment.

capacity_exhausted.message: RightNow System Zero is at capacity. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

concurrency_limit_exceeded.message: This account has reached its concurrent call limit. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

daily_dispatch_limit.message: This account reached today's request limit. It resets at 00:00 UTC.

document_not_available.message: Documents are unavailable. Send the request without the document attachment.

https_required.message: This API answers only over HTTPS. Send the request to the https address.

idempotency_conflict.message: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry with the same key shortly.

idempotency_key_reuse.message: This idempotency key already settled another request.

idempotency_replay_unavailable.message: The answer to this request is no longer stored. Send it again with a new Idempotency-Key.

idempotency_replayed_error.message: The original request failed. Its stored error response is replayed.

idempotency_unavailable.message: Replay protection is temporarily unavailable. Retry this request with the same Idempotency-Key.

image_not_available.message: Images are unavailable. Send the request without the image attachment.

injection_suspected.message: The request was refused because its content reads as instructions to the model. Remove the embedded instructions and send it again.

input_quarantined.message: This exact input caused repeated serving failures, so it is refused for up to 24 hours. Change the input or contact support.

internal_error.message: The request failed unexpectedly. Retry the request. Keep the request id if the failure persists.

invalid_idempotency_key.message: Idempotency-Key must be nonblank ASCII and 255 characters or less.

invalid_request.message: The RightNow System Zero request is invalid.

invalid_trace_header.message: X-Client-Request-Id must be nonblank ASCII and 512 characters or less.

limiter_unavailable.message: API rate limiting is temporarily unavailable. Please retry shortly.

long_recording_not_available.message: This input type is not supported.

maintenance.message: The API is down for maintenance. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

method_not_allowed.message: The HTTP method is not supported by this endpoint.

model_not_found.message: The requested model is not available.

monthly_cap_reached.message: This workspace reached its monthly decision cap.

payload_too_large.message: The request exceeds the body limit. Send fewer or smaller attachments.

question_not_grounded.message: The question cannot be answered from this state.

question_too_large.message: The question exceeds the size limit.

questions_too_large.message: The questions exceed the reply or token limit. Send fewer or shorter questions.

rate_limit_exceeded.message: Too many requests from this key or address. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

request_refused.message: System Zero refused this request. Change it before sending it again.

service_unavailable.message: RightNow System Zero cannot serve this request right now. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

state_too_large.message: The state exceeds the size or nesting limit.

state_too_large_unguarded.message: This release does not answer states of this length. Shorten or split the state.

system_zero_timeout.message: RightNow System Zero exceeded the response deadline.

system_zero_unavailable.message: RightNow System Zero is temporarily unavailable.

unknown_endpoint.message: The requested API endpoint was not found.

video_not_available.message: This input type is not supported.

workspace_limit_exceeded.message: This workspace is over one of its own allowances, such as calls in flight or bytes being read. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

workspace_quarantined.message: This account's requests are paused for up to an hour after repeated serving failures. Contact support.
